I am 78 years old and have farmed this land in Iringa for many years. On this small plot of maize that I intercrop with beans, I will use manure from my cattle because buying chemical fertilizer is too expensive for such a small piece of land. I will plant the local seed I saved from last season and rely on rainfall, as I always have. My family will do most of the work, but I may hire a few young men to help with the heavy digging at the start of the season.
